verdict.rationale: Veo is operated by natural-language text prompts, with documented improved prompt adherence and multi-turn conversational editing (element replacement, perspective changes) through the Interactions API. Hands-on reports show imperfect prompt adherence, with specifics missed or misinterpreted, but prompt-driven operation itself works as documented. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of multi-turn conversational editing, reliable adherence to detailed instructions, evidence that natural language alone suffices without special cinematic parameter notation or tokens.
